description.message: Translate or read selected text with Sonuvi from your browser context menu.

missing.message: Enable the browser connection in Sonuvi → Settings → General first.

setup.message: Enable the browser connection in Sonuvi → Settings → General. Then select text on a webpage and right-click → Sonuvi.

privacy.message: Only text you choose using the context menu is sent to Sonuvi on this Mac. The extension does not read other page content or access your API key.
